verdict.rationale: The only evidence of acting on many items at once is the cohort API, which can upload or export a whole cohort (many users) in one call, plus a project-wide event data export. Neither is framed as a bulk-operations feature. The Taxonomy API's create/get/update/delete is documented per item, not as batch editing. Missing for 10: documented bulk update/delete across many items (events, properties, charts, flags), bulk actions exposed via the MCP server or AI tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
